prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Miniature Beasts Station PODS screen concept, a flat screen design that fills the whole 16:9 canvas edge to edge (the outer 2 percent at left and right is bleed, trimmed later to 1024x600). Not a device photograph: no bezel, no buttons, no hands. Design at 1024x600 first: large shapes, few words, nothing smaller than 14 px type.
STYLE: exactly the approved Station look of the supplied Home screen: a hardware research instrument, deep blue-teal ground, graphite and slate chrome with fine bevels and hairline rules, small round status lamps, enamel, brushed metal and glass; one key light from the upper left, clean painted light with soft cast shadows, crisp edges, no noise, grain or dither; smooth sans-serif type (like Inter), cream on dark, small and quiet. The pod on its nest is the one warm, bright thing on the screen; everything else is cool and calm. No wood, no felt, no shelves, no lamp fixture drawn. Labels are one small engraved word, low contrast, read second: the object leads.
LAYOUT: a thin graphite top bar (40 px) and bottom line (38 px). At the left a slim slate RACK COLUMN (160 px wide): six round wells in a vertical row, three holding smooth seed-pods (green, blue, violet), three empty, the top well lifted with a thin cream focus ring; at its foot a return GATE, a slate hatch with an engraved leaf mark. The stage is a large circular MICROSCOPE STAGE PLATE of brushed slate seen slightly from above, about 460 px across, centred right of the rack, with a thin engraved ring and four tick marks; the FINGERPRINT WHORL is engraved into the plate's rim as four petal fields of nested ridges around the circle, only the top-left petal lit in charcoal with a tiny cream dot. At the plate's centre the pod on a padded cream nest: a sealed plum-sized seed-pod, warm green ribbed shell with an embossed three-leaf mark, its top faintly translucent so a hopper's squat silhouette shows inside; a cool beam from above-left pools warm on it, the brightest thing on screen. Around the plate, at the four compass points of the upper half, FOUR TRAIT VIEWPORTS: round machined slate lenses about 160 px across with a bevelled ring, an engraved emblem (a swirl, a crown, a drop, a paw), a small lamp and one quiet word under each. States: (1) MARKINGS, clear: a close warm sculpted drawing of a plain charcoal flank with a small misty pearl seed resting at its rim holding a ghost of pale cream islands; (2) CROWN: frosted pale blue-white with one small four-point star glinting, nothing behind the frost; (3) COLOUR: frosted, nothing behind it; (4) GAIT: frosted, two small joined rings engraved on its ring. A small enamel name plate on the plate's front edge.
TEXT, exactly these and nothing else: top bar left "Pods  T5"; top bar centre a yellow lightning bolt "9", a blue diamond "4", a green drop "6"; top bar right "Companion away · with Dot". On a small plate under the nest "Hopper pod" large and "rock field · a hopper felt safe" small. One small engraved word under each viewport: "markings", "crown", "colour", "gait". Under the first viewport a small line "shows plain · hides pale". Bottom line: orange "✓ Study crown · 2" with a small blue diamond and grey "← Home" at left, grey "Hopper pod · identified" in the middle, grey "crown glints · something new" at right.
Constraints: no letters, ratios, percentages, DNA helices, codes or genes anywhere; frosted panes show frost only, never a blurred creature behind; no tables, title bars, bullet lists, progress bars or boxed buttons; no logos; no creature outside the window drawing and the faint silhouette in the shell; no people.
preamble: Reference images follow; their roles are stated. Image 1 is the approved Station Home screen: match its chrome, module materials, light and type exactly so the two screens read as one device; do not copy its layout. Image 2 is the approved pod in its cradle under a beam: the anchor for the pod and nest. Image 3 is the accepted rich Pip, the hopper whose traits the windows describe.

imageInputs.role: approved Station Home concept: the device's chrome, modules, light and type that Pods must match; not layout
approved pod in its cradle under a beam: the anchor for the specimen stage; its icons and type are not specs
accepted rich Pip, the hopper: the species whose traits the markings window draws (plain charcoal flank; pale islands as the hidden look)
